question: What conduct should a practitioner with an equal mind abandon through practice?
premises: Practice leads to an equal mind
Village customs are identified as something to abandon
The abandonment is prescribed as a rule
inference: Through practice, one who has attained an equal mind should abandon village customs.
uncertainties: grāma-dharmañ may refer broadly to conventional social duties
plain_english: Through practice, becoming even-minded, one should abandon the customs of village life.
